title: RuneScape: Dragonwilds 1.0.1 UPDATE! ⚔️ NEW Combat, Ring Slots & Spellbook Changes!
author: EpochOG Gaming
description:
🔥 RuneScape: Dragonwilds 1.0.1 is HERE, and some of the biggest changes aren't just about dealing more damage!

In today's EpochOG Gaming video, we're breaking down some of my favorite changes from the new 1.0.1 Eye on Ashenfall update on PS5!

⚔️ NEW JUMP ATTACKS!
🏹 NEW BOW SPECIAL ATTACKS!
💍 NEW RING & AMULET SLOTS!
📖 SPELLBOOK QUALITY-OF-LIFE IMPROVEMENTS!
🎒 EXPANDED INVENTORY & MORE!

As a newer RuneScape: Dragonwilds player who's already reached Fell Hollow with Power Level 5 equipment, I wanted to share my perspective on what these updates mean for combat, exploration, and character progression.

🔥 **WHAT WE'RE COVERING:**

⚔️ **Death From Above — New Jump Attack!**
A new Skill Tree perk allows players to unleash powerful plunging attacks. We're also looking at how Windstep fits into this new combat mechanic.

🏹 **NEW BOW SPECIAL ATTACKS!**
- Shortbow: Rapid Fire
- Longbow: Power Shot
- Crossbow: Heavy Bolt
- New Ranged perks, including Ammo Recovery and Low Blow!

💍 **RING & AMULET SLOTS — THINK BEYOND DAMAGE!**
Many players are focused on maximizing raw damage, but I'm looking at something different: skill progression!

With dedicated Ring and Amulet slots, players have more flexibility to experiment with equipment bonuses alongside food and potions for XP-focused builds. Exact bonus stacking depends on the items and effects being used.

📖 **SPELLBOOK QUALITY OF LIFE!**
We're looking at the spell selection controls, including direct spell selection and navigating spells with L1/R1 on PS5.

🎒 **MORE INVENTORY SPACE!**
Inventory capacity has increased from 32 to 40 slots, giving us more room to gather materials, explore vaults, and carry equipment.

🐉 **ADDITIONAL IMPROVEMENTS!**
Reduced enemy aggro range, longer enemy respawn times, save fixes, and more changes to make exploring Ashenfall smoother.

These are some of the improvements that stood out to me as a newer player, and I'm excited to see how they affect the game moving forward!

📖 **OFFICIAL PATCH 1.0.1 NOTES:**
https://dragonwilds.runescape.com/news/eye-on-ashenfall-1-0-1

💬 QUESTION FOR THE COMMUNITY:
Are you using the new Ring and Amulet slots for raw damage, skill progression, or a combination of both?

Let me know in the comments!

👍 LIKE if you enjoy these Dragonwilds updates!
🔔 SUBSCRIBE to EpochOG Gaming for more PS5 gameplay, weapon guides, boss fights, vault walkthroughs, and RuneScape: Dragonwilds content.
